main_text.p: quod in onerum modo,quem pro rato pro- [?] vincia hæc tenetur sustinere, ex tributis & censib. jam usitatis solui non poteft, id conficiatur ex quintâ censu aut proventus omnium bonorum immobilium,agrorum pariter & ædificiorum,rusticorum urbanorum q;, ex formâ anni M. D. LXXVII; & hoc servetur, donec de modo alio partes convenerint,aut aliter ab ordinib. generalib. fuerit decretum. Cætera actionis huius nondum satis explicata ac probata explicentur & probentur plenius, ut ferri sententia possit; & teneantur oppidani rei respondere peremptorie. Interea quæ servanda sint in usu juris STAPVLÆ, recensent & præcipiunt ex formula Cobelia aut Albana, de tempore proponendi in publico mercés,de loco, de indice earum, ex quib. vectigal fori solutum, de modo vectigalis certo in singulas mercium species: interdicuntque oppidanis institutione novorum vectigalium & aggravatione veterum: addunt de trutinæ cura & inspectione contra fraudes. Denique de Oldermanno, & ijs, qui illo in subsellio de STAPVLÆ jure judicant, subijciunt; statuuntq;, ne Oldermannus carens semiplena probatione quenq; ad jusjurandum adigat, utq; accusatus in hoc casu velut innocens absolvatur, Oldermannus vero in sumptus, & poena pro excessus modo arbitrariam condemnetur: ut femi-

page.notes: The first line ends with "pro ratio pro-" and the printed hyphen is unclear, so the reading "pro rato pro-" is doubtful. The reading "sustinere" uses a long s that looks like f in print; the text has been normalised to s. The last word of the running head may carry a printed stop. Words with "STAPVLÆ" are printed in capitals in the running text, as shown. The catchword "plena" was taken from the foot of the page.
